editorial_rules.instruction: Use at most 25 words in each prose sentence. This project limit does not replace STE instruction rules.
Remove stock phrases and generic praise. The checker detects only its listed phrases.
Write full word forms. Do not use contractions.
Use the glossary names. The checker reports the listed avoid forms.
Give evidence for each progress claim. Remove repetition and unsupported conclusions.
Review each new technical term before you add it. State its meaning and source.

coverage.description: Count words in prose sentences. Inspect live JSON records and AGENTS.md. Planning files, schemas, and fictional examples are outside this check.
Detect a fixed list of filler phrases. This check cannot detect all poor writing.
Detect common English contractions in prose.
Detect exact avoid forms from the technical glossary. Unknown terms and meanings need manual review.
Check evidence, repetition, relevance, and the meaning of progress claims before approval.
Review new domain terms and their sources. Do not add ordinary English words to bypass a finding.
Check approved words, their word classes, and meanings against Issue 9. A complete STE dictionary check is not implemented.
Review the applicable Issue 9 writing rules. The project checks do not establish compliance with those rules.
